summary: Summarise why the packaging's weight and volume are the minimum needed. From 1 Jan 2030 this is mandatory (Art 10); writing it now per Annex IV criterion lets you spot reduction potential early.
总结为何包装重量和体积已是所需最低。自 2030-01-01 起强制（Art 10）；现在按 Annex IV 准则撰写有助于及早发现减量空间。
terms: Minimum necessary
必要最低
The lowest weight and volume that still ensures functionality incl. product protection (Art 10(1)).
仍能确保功能（包括产品保护）的最低重量与体积（Art 10(1)）。
logic: Art 10(4): the TD explains the specifications used, the design requirement per Annex IV criterion that prevents further reduction, and the tests/studies used.
Art 10(4)：技术文档须说明所用规范、各 Annex IV 准则下阻止进一步减量的设计要求，以及所用测试/研究。
Annex IV Part B: substituting one material for another is not sufficient evidence of minimisation.
Annex IV Part B：仅以一种材料替代另一种不足以证明最小化。
info: Per criterion (1-8): the limiting design requirement and the evidence ID (C09-30…C09-34).
按准则（1-8）：限制性设计要求及证据编号（C09-30…C09-34）。
Calculation of the minimum weight/volume and batch variation.
最低重量/体积计算及批次差异。
minimum: 已涉及 Annex IV 准则
keywords:concl:protect|manufactur|logistic|function|information|hygien|safety|legal|保护|制造|物流|功能|信息|卫生|安全|法律:4
recommended: Record the reduction options investigated and why they failed
记录研究过的减量方案及失败原因
steps: Go through the 8 Annex IV criteria and write one sentence each on what limits further reduction.
逐项检查 Annex IV 的 8 项准则，各写一句限制进一步减量的因素。
Cite the tests (C09-30, C09-32).
Write the overall conclusion.
写出总体结论。
good: Board 350 → 300 g/m² failed compression (TST-003); size set by A5 product + 2 mm clearance; info panel needs 40 cm²; → current design is the minimum.
纸板 350 → 300 g/m² 未通过压缩测试（TST-003）；尺寸由 A5 产品 + 2 mm 间隙决定；信息面需 40 cm²；→ 当前设计已为最低。

summary: Grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging: calculate the empty-space ratio (must be ≤ 50 % from 2030). Sales packaging: empty space must be the minimum necessary by 12 Feb 2028.
组合、运输和电商包装：计算空隙率（2030 年起须 ≤ 50%）。销售包装：2028-02-12 前空隙须为必要最低。
terms: Empty space
空隙
Outer volume minus the volume of the sales packaging inside; filling material counts as empty space (Art 24(3)).
外包装体积减去内装销售包装体积；填充物计为空隙（Art 24(3)）。
logic: Art 24(1): ≤ 50 % for grouped/transport/e-commerce from 1 Jan 2030 (or 3 years after the method implementing act).
Art 24(1)：组合/运输/电商包装自 2030-01-01（或方法实施法案生效后 3 年）起 ≤ 50%。
Art 24(4): sales packaging minimum empty space by 12 Feb 2028.
Art 24(4)：销售包装 2028-02-12 前空隙须最小化。
info: Outer volume, contents volume, ratio %, filling material used.
外体积、内容物体积、比例 %、所用填充物。
minimum: Assessment with ratio % (grouped/transport/e-commerce) or the rationale (sales)
评估及比例 %（组合/运输/电商）或理由（销售包装）
steps: Compute outer volume L×W×H; sum the volumes of the sales units inside; ratio = (outer − inside)/outer.
计算外体积 长×宽×高；求内装销售单元体积之和；比例 =（外 − 内）/ 外。
good: Case 600×400×350 mm = 84 L; 48 cartons × 1.24 L = 59.5 L; empty space 29 % ≤ 50 % ✓.
bad: 只有比例，没有所用体积。

help: 给出体积及所得百分比。

summary: Show where the manufacturer's name (or trade name / trademark) and postal address appear on the packaging — required since 12 Aug 2026 (Art 15(6)).
说明制造商名称（或商号 / 商标）及邮寄地址在包装上的位置——自 2026-08-12 起强制（Art 15(6)）。
terms: Manufacturer (Art 3)
制造商（Art 3）
Who manufactures packaging or has it designed/manufactured under its own name or trademark.
生产包装，或以自身名称或商标委托设计/生产包装的人。
logic: Art 15(6): name + single postal address (+ electronic contact where available) on the packaging or via QR / accompanying document when not possible.
Art 15(6)：名称 + 单一邮寄地址（如有，另附电子联系方式）须在包装上，无法标注时可通过二维码 / 随附文件。
Art 15(7): legible and must not obscure other mandatory information.
Art 15(7)：须清晰易读，且不得遮挡其他强制信息。
info: Panel / position and the exact text printed.
版面 / 位置及印刷的准确文字。
minimum: 已上传 Artwork / 照片证据
recommended: Close-up photo of the printed address
steps: Find the address on the final artwork (C03-12); note the panel; upload a close-up.
在最终 Artwork（C03-12）上找到地址；记录版面；上传特写。
good: Back panel, bottom left: 'Lumen Colour Cards GmbH, Hafenstr. 12, 20457 Hamburg, DE, info@…'.
背面左下：“Lumen Colour Cards GmbH, Hafenstr. 12, 20457 Hamburg, DE, info@…”。
bad: 只有网址，没有邮寄地址。

summary: Show the type, batch or serial number (or other element) that identifies the packaging — required since 12 Aug 2026 (Art 15(5)). You may choose which one (Commission FAQ).
说明可识别包装的型号、批号或序列号（或其他要素）——自 2026-08-12 起强制（Art 15(5)）。可自行选择其一（委员会 FAQ）。
logic: If the packaging is too small, the information may be in a document accompanying the product.
如包装过小，可在随产品文件中提供。
minimum: Photo / artwork showing the code uploaded
已上传显示编码的照片 / Artwork
recommended: Use the same code in your release records (C13-53)
在放行记录（C13-53）中使用同一编码
steps: Upload a photo of the printed code and describe its format in the remarks.
上传印刷编码的照片，并在备注中描述其格式。
good: Lot code 'L26-245-03' ink-jet printed on the bottom flap.
bad: Code printed on the shipping case only, not on the sales unit.
编码只印在运输箱上，未印在销售单元上。

summary: Analyse what could make this packaging non-compliant (per applicable article), how likely and severe that is, and how you control it. Annex VII requires this risk analysis in the TD.
分析哪些因素可能导致包装不符合（按适用条款）、可能性和严重程度，以及如何控制。Annex VII 要求技术文档包含该风险分析。
terms: Risk of non-conformity
不符合风险
A plausible way the packaging could fail an applicable requirement.
包装可能不满足适用要求的合理途径。
logic: Annex VII point 2: the TD 'shall include an adequate analysis and assessment of the risks of non-conformity'.
Annex VII 第 2 点：技术文档“须包含对不符合风险的充分分析与评估”。
info: Per applicable article: cause, likelihood, severity, control measure, evidence ID.
按适用条款：原因、可能性、严重程度、控制措施、证据编号。
recommended: Include supplier change and ink/adhesive substitution as risk causes
将供应商变更及油墨/胶黏剂替换列为风险原因
steps: List each applicable article from the Overview matrix.
从概览矩阵列出每个适用条款。
For each: what could go wrong, how you prevent/detect it, which evidence shows it.
逐条说明：可能出什么问题、如何预防/发现、由哪项证据证明。
Upload as RPT.
以 RPT 类型上传。
good: Art 5(4) — new ink supplier with Pb pigments (low/high) — supplier change notification + re-test (C15-65, TST-005).
Art 5(4)——新油墨供应商使用含铅颜料（低/高）——供应商变更通知 + 重新检测（C15-65、TST-005）。
bad: Generic FMEA unrelated to PPWR requirements.
与 PPWR 要求无关的通用 FMEA。

summary: List every standard or technical specification you used to assess or test the packaging, with edition and the requirement it covers. This list goes into TD §16 and DoC point 6.
列出评估或检测包装所用的每项标准或技术规范，含版本及所涵盖的要求。该清单将进入 TD §16 及 DoC 第 6 点。
terms: Presumption of conformity
符合性推定
Only standards published in the OJ under the PPWR (none yet) give it; the old PPWD standards are guidance only.
只有依据 PPWR 在官方公报公布的标准（目前尚无）才产生推定；原 PPWD 标准仅作指引。
logic: Annex VII 2(d) requires the list of harmonised standards, common specifications or other technical specifications applied — or the solutions adopted.
Annex VII 2(d) 要求列出所采用的协调标准、共同规范或其他技术规范——或所采取的解决方案。
Do not claim presumption of conformity for EN 13427-13432 (Commission FAQ 2026).
不要对 EN 13427-13432 声称符合性推定（委员会 FAQ 2026）。
info: Standard, edition, clause, requirement covered, evidence ID.
标准、版本、条款、涵盖要求、证据编号。
recommended: 将原 PPWD 标准标注为“指引”
steps: Add one row per standard / test method used (e.g. EN 13657 for heavy-metal digestion).
每项所用标准 / 检测方法一行（如重金属消解 EN 13657）。
good: EN 13430:2004 · all · Art 6 (guidance) · RPT-001 | EN 13657:2002 · digestion · Art 5(4) · TST-001.

summary: Collect a signed PPWR compliance statement from each supplier of a key component. Suppliers must give you the information you need (Art 16).
向每个关键组件的供应商收集签署的 PPWR 符合性声明。供应商须向您提供所需信息（Art 16）。
logic: Art 16(1): suppliers provide all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity.
Art 16(1)：供应商须提供证明符合性所需的全部信息和文件。
info: Supplier, material / trace code, articles covered, values or report numbers, date, signature, change-notification commitment.
供应商、材料/追溯码、涵盖条款、数值或报告编号、日期、签名、变更通知承诺。
minimum: Supplier statement uploaded or valid supplier-library certificate
已上传供应商声明或供应商库证书有效
recommended: Statement references Regulation (EU) 2025/40 and specific articles
声明引用 (EU) 2025/40 法规及具体条款
steps: Send the supplier the statement template (download below); upload the signed copy.
向供应商发送声明模板（下方下载）；上传签署件。
good: Rhein Wellpappe — CB-BF250-2025B — Art 5(4) < 40 mg/kg (report PRTC-2025-1187) — signed 2026-03-01 — will notify changes 30 days in advance.
Rhein Wellpappe — CB-BF250-2025B — Art 5(4) < 40 mg/kg（报告 PRTC-2025-1187）— 2026-03-01 签署 — 承诺提前 30 天通知变更。

summary: Enter the data for the EU declaration of conformity: DoC number, TD reference, signatory and place. The platform fills the rest from your project (Annex VIII).
填写欧盟符合性声明的数据：DoC 编号、技术文档引用、签署人及签发地点。其余内容由平台根据项目填充（Annex VIII）。
terms: Signatory
签署人
Person authorised to sign for and on behalf of the manufacturer, who thereby assumes responsibility (Art 39(4)).
被授权代表制造商签署、并由此承担责任的人（Art 39(4)）。
logic: Art 15(2): DoC only after compliance is demonstrated; Annex VIII gives the structure; one DoC per packaging type.
Art 15(2)：证明符合后方可出具 DoC；Annex VIII 规定结构；每种包装类型一份 DoC。
Art 39(2): continuously updated — the platform flags 'update required' after changes.
Art 39(2)：须持续更新——变更后平台会标记“需更新”。
info: DoC number, TD number/version, signatory name and function, place of issue.
DoC 编号、技术文档编号/版本、签署人姓名及职务、签发地点。
minimum: DoC number, TD number, signatory and place entered
已填写 DoC 编号、技术文档编号、签署人及地点
recommended: Number pattern with year and packaging system, e.g. DoC-2026-09-PS001
编号含年份与包装系统，如 DoC-2026-09-PS001
steps: Choose the DoC number; enter the TD number shown on the TD & DoC tab; name the signatory and function; enter the place.
确定 DoC 编号；填写“TD 与 DoC”页显示的技术文档编号；填写签署人及职务；填写地点。
good: DoC-2026-09-PS001 · TD-PRJ-2026-001 v3 · Dr A. Weber, Head of Quality · Hamburg.
DoC-2026-09-PS001 · TD-PRJ-2026-001 v3 · Dr A. Weber，质量负责人 · 汉堡。
bad: 签署人为顾问（须由制造商签署）。

sign.ph: Dr A. Weber, Head of Quality
help: Name and function of the authorised person.
msg: Add the function after a comma, e.g. ', Head of Quality'.
请在逗号后补充职务，如“, 质量负责人”。
